e.title: GeM Sahayak：把「保险保证债券」当作印度政府采购的投标保证金讲清楚，并主动声明自己的八种译文未经母语者审阅
e.title_en: GeM Sahayak: explaining insurance surety bonds as bid security in Indian public procurement, while stating outright that its own eight translations have not been reviewed by native speakers
e.title_hk: GeM Sahayak：把「保險保證債券」當作印度政府採購的投標保證金講清楚，並主動聲明自己的八種譯文未經母語者審閱
e.summary: 一个关于「保险保证债券作为投标保证金」的教育性参考站点：说明该工具是什么、它依据何种监管框架被采用、以及取得一份的流程；单页无构建步骤，界面字符串以键值对形式放在一个 i18n 文件里并支持十种语言（含八种印度文字），另附一份三十页的申请流程演示文稿与所引用的政府原始文件；它明确声明八种非英文译文尚未经母语者审阅、且法律术语在依赖前应先核实
e.summary_hk: 一個關於「保險保證債券作為投標保證金」的教育性參考站點：說明該工具是什麼、它依據何種監管框架被採用、以及取得一份的流程；單頁無構建步驟，界面字符串以鍵值對形式放在一個 i18n 檔案裡並支援十種語言（含八種印度文字），另附一份三十頁的申請流程演示文稿與所引用的政府原始文件；它明確聲明八種非英文譯文尚未經母語者審閱、且法律術語在依賴前應先核實
e.summary_en: An educational reference site on insurance surety bonds used as bid security: it explains what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted and how to obtain one; it is a single page with no build step, its interface strings live as key-value pairs in one i18n file across ten languages including eight Indian scripts, and it ships a thirty-slide application walkthrough deck plus the source government documents it cites; it states explicitly that its eight non-English translations have not been reviewed by native speakers and that legal terms should be verified before it is relied upon
e.body:
**GeM Sahayak** 是一个**关于「保险保证债券作为投标保证金」的教育性参考站点**（仓库 `axt-asmi/gem-sahayak`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 31,056 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送于 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，均在**解冻窗口之后****）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 1,300 字节**（**本批最短**）。**已实测存在的关键文件（均 HTTP 200）**：**`index.html`、`i18n.js`、`serve.py`、`how-to-apply.pdf`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把边界写成清单」**中的**第四种，也是唯一一条把「我自己的产出不可尽信」写得最直接的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**标题逐字为「GeM Sahayak — Surety Bonds」**；⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「An educational reference on **Insurance Surety Bonds as Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)** on the **Government e-Marketplace (GeM)**: **what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted, and the procedure for obtaining one**.」**——**即「一份关于**保险保证债券作为投标保证金（EMD）**在**政府电子市场（GeM）**上的教育性参考：**该工具是什么、它在何种监管框架下被采用、以及取得一份的流程****」。**其内容构成逐字为**：**`index.html`（**单页，无构建步骤**）**；**`i18n.js`（**十种语言的译文**）**；**`docs/`（**被监管时间轴所引用的政府原始文件**）**；**`how-to-apply.pdf`（**申请流程演示文稿，30 页**）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「保险保证债券作为投标保证金」这一险种用法，是本条目在险种设计上最值得记的一点**——**逐字见上**。⭐⭐ **对做保险创新的学生，这是一种**与常规财产／责任险完全不同的功能**：**它不是赔付损失，而是**替投标人向采购方提供履约信用****——**即**保证（surety）**这一类业务**；**其经济实质是**以保险公司的信用替代现金或银行保函形式的投标保证金****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该工具的监管依据、费率结构或适用条件**——**本次未读其正文与所引政府文件**；**⚠️ 亦**未核实 GeM 上是否确实接受该工具、以及规模如何**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「该工具是什么、依据何种监管框架被采用、以及如何取得」这一三段式结构，是本条目在写作方法上最值得记的**——**逐字见上**。⭐⭐ **对需要向他人解释一个陌生金融工具的学生，这是一份**最小可用的说明结构**：**定义 → 监管依据（含时间轴）→ 操作流程**；**而它把**政府原始文件**放进 `docs/` 并让**监管时间轴直接引用这些文件****（**逐字为「`docs/` — source government documents **linked from the regulatory timelines**」**）——**即**结论可追到原文****（**可与第 333 轮 [[proof-protocol]] 的「证据随主张同行」并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**未核对其 `docs/` 下收录的文件清单或其准确性**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「八种非英文译文尚未经母语者审阅，且法律术语在依赖前应先核实」是本条目的核心，也是本轮主题最直接的一种形态**——**逐字为**：**「> The **eight non-English translations have not yet been reviewed by native speakers**. **Legal terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) should be verified before this is relied upon.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 它声明的是**自己刚做出来的那部分**（译文）**不可尽信****，**而非泛泛的免责**；**② 它**点名了三个具体法律术语**（**obligee 权利人／担保受益人、bid security 投标担保、EMD 投标保证金**）——**即它指出**读者最可能被误导的三处****；**③ 其条件句措辞为「**before this is relied upon**」**——**即**不是「仅供参考」的套话，而是指明依赖前须完成的一步****。**对做多语言保险材料的同学，这条是**把「翻译质量」与「法律准确性」分开声明**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其英文原文本身准确**——**本次未核对其内容与所引政府文件**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **十种语言的构成逐字实测，且含八种印度文字**：**English、हिंदी（印地语）、**Hinglish（印地语－英语混写）**、বাংলা（孟加拉语）、मराठी（马拉地语）、ગુજરાતી（古吉拉特语）、தமிழ்（泰米尔语）、తెలుగు（泰卢固语）、ಕನ್ನಡ（卡纳达语）、മലയാളം（马拉雅拉姆语）**⭐⭐ **两点值得记**：**① **Hinglish**（印地语用拉丁字母书写的混写体）被单列为一种语言**——**这是一种**实务中真实存在却少见于正式本地化清单**的书写形态**；**② 其余八种均为印度主要语言且各有独立文字****——**对做印度市场保险材料的同学，这是一份**该国语言覆盖的实用清单**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该清单覆盖印度全部主要语言**——**例如旁遮普语、奥里雅语等未列出**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **「所有字符串以键值对形式集中在一个 i18n 文件里，缺键回退到英文」是本条目在工程上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「All strings live in `i18n.js` as **key–value pairs**. **Missing keys fall back to English.**」**⭐⭐ **对做多语言交付的同学，这是一个**最小且可审查**的做法**：**译文不在多处散落，而是在一个文件里**（**可与本站 [[llm-wiki]]、[[md-translator]]、[[action-translation]]、[[seo-hreflang]] 等多语言条目并读**）；**而「缺键回退英文」是一条**明确的降级规则****——**即使某语言漏译，页面也不会显示空白或键名**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其回退在实现中确实生效**——**未读 `i18n.js`**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **「单页、无构建步骤」与其运行方式逐字实测，是本站少见的一种交付形态**：**逐字为「`index.html` — the site (**single page, no build step**)」**；**运行方式逐字为**：**`python3 serve.py 8777 .` 后访问 `http://localhost:8777`**；**并逐字说明**：**「`serve.py` sends **no-cache headers** so edits appear on a normal reload.」**⭐⭐ **两点值得记**：**① **无构建步骤**意味着**任何能打开 HTML 的人都能改它**——**对做教学材料的同学，这是**门槛最低的交付形态****；**② 「开发服务器发送 no-cache 头」是一个**具体的可用性细节****（**避免改了文件却看到旧页面**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **「三十页申请流程演示文稿」逐字实测且是**该工具的操作层****——**逐字为「`how-to-apply.pdf` — the application walkthrough deck (**30 slides**)」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未打开该 PDF**——**故不转述其申请步骤**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其免责声明逐字，且含一处与主题直接相关的自述**：**「This is an **educational awareness resource**. **It is not owned or maintained by any government authority** and **does not constitute legal or financial advice**.」**⭐⭐ **「不隶属于任何政府机构」值得单独记**：**一份讲**政府电子市场**规则的参考材料，主动声明**自己不是官方****——**即**把「我讲的是别人的规则」与「我就是那个机构」分开****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其内容与官方规则一致**——**本次未核对任何政府原文**）。**⑨ ⭐ **可与本站印度保险与学习资源条目并读**：[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[iai-india]]、[[indian-health-claims-skill]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[actuarial-student-competitions]]、[[md-translator]]、[[llm-wiki]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**GitHub API 许可字段实测为 `NONE`**，**且其 README 的「Contents」一节中未列出 `LICENSE` 文件**，**README 全文亦**未作任何许可声明****（**本条属「完全未声明」一类**；**未声明许可即默认保留全部权利**，**使用、复制、修改或再分发其页面、译文、演示文稿与所收录政府文件前必须自行确认授权状况**）；**⚠️ 另需提示一点**：**其 `docs/` 目录自述收录「source government documents」**——**即**它把第三方政府文件纳入仓库****；**这些文件本身的再利用条件**可能与仓库代码不同**（**⚠️ 本条**未核对其 `docs/` 下文件清单，**亦**未核实**这些政府文件的再利用条款**；**本词条**不主张**该收录方式符合任何再利用条件**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（1,300 字节）全文的定位段、内容构成四项、十种语言清单、译文未审阅声明、运行方式与 no-cache 说明、以及免责声明**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `index.html`、`i18n.js`、`serve.py`、`how-to-apply.pdf` 四个文件存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未打开站点（`index.html` 与 `i18n.js` 的内容本次未读）、未运行 `serve.py`、未打开 `how-to-apply.pdf`、未读 `docs/` 下任何政府文件、未以任何语言实际浏览该站点****，因此**不能转述其正文解释、监管时间轴内容、申请步骤或任一语言的译文**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其关于**保险保证债券**的说明是否准确**——**包括该工具的定义、被采纳的监管依据与时间轴、以及在 GeM 上使用它的实际程序**（**本次未读其正文，亦未查阅任何印度政府原文或印度保险监管与发展局的规则**）；**本词条**不主张**其内容准确、现行或完整**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其**八种非英文译文的实际质量****——**⚠️ 作者本人已声明这八种译文**未经母语者审阅****；**本词条据此**不主张**任一译文可用于任何正式用途**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其三个点名术语（**obligee／bid security／EMD**）在各语言中的译法**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其术语选择在任何辖区法律上正确**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实** GeM 是否确实接受**保险保证债券**作为投标保证金、以及该做法当前的适用范围与规模**（**本次未查 GeM 官方规则**）；**本词条**不主张**该工具在当前政策下仍可如此使用**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其 `docs/` 下收录的政府文件是否**完整、为现行版本、且未被改动****——**⚠️ 这一点在多语言与法律类材料中直接影响可依赖性**；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**「缺键回退到英文」在 `i18n.js` 中是否确实生效**；**⑨ ⭐ **未核实**其六张（或更多）界面在十种语言下的实际渲染效果**（**本次未打开站点**）；**⚠️ 尤其**未核实印度各文字在实际浏览器字体下的可读性**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **该项目自述为**教育性认知材料**并明确不构成法律或财务意见、且不隶属任何政府机构****；**本词条据此**不主张**其可用于任何真实的投标决策、法律判断、合规操作或采购活动**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-07、推送于 2026-09-08**，**关注度极低**；**⚠️ 其仓库体量实测为 **31,056 KB**，**而 README 仅 1,300 字节**——**即**体积主要由站点与演示文稿构成，而非文档**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实该体积的具体来源**；**80% 以上可能来自 PDF 与图片，**但本次未列出其目录树**；**此为本词条的观察，非作者自述**）；**⑫ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑬ **README 为英文**——**本词条已如实记入；**⚠️ 其站点支持十种语言，**但本次未核实除 README 外哪些内容有译文**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/axt-asmi/gem-sahayak` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 1,300 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`index.html`、`i18n.js`、`serve.py`、`how-to-apply.pdf` 经 raw 探测确认存在（HTTP 200）**；**未克隆、未打开站点、未运行、未读任何政府文件与 PDF**。
e.body_hk:
**GeM Sahayak** 是一個**關於「保險保證債券作為投標保證金」的教育性參考站點**（倉庫 `axt-asmi/gem-sahayak`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 HTML、體量 31,056 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送於 2026-09-08**（**均在解凍窗口之後**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 1,300 位元組**（**本批最短**）。**已實測存在的關鍵文件（均 HTTP 200）**：**`index.html`、`i18n.js`、`serve.py`、`how-to-apply.pdf`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把邊界寫成清單」**中的**第四種，也是唯一一條把「我自己的產出不可盡信」寫得最直接的一種**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**標題逐字「GeM Sahayak — Surety Bonds」**；⭐⭐⭐ **定位逐字**：**「An educational reference on **Insurance Surety Bonds as Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)** on the **Government e-Marketplace (GeM)**: **what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted, and the procedure for obtaining one**.」**。**內容構成逐字**：**`index.html`（**單頁，無構建步驟**）**；**`i18n.js`（**十種語言的譯文**）**；**`docs/`（**被監管時間軸所引用的政府原始文件**）**；**`how-to-apply.pdf`（**申請流程演示文稿，30 頁**）**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「保險保證債券作為投標保證金」這一險種用法，是險種設計上最值得記的一點****⭐⭐ **它**不是賠付損失，而是**替投標人向採購方提供履約信用****——**即**保證（surety）**這一類業務**；**其經濟實質是**以保險公司的信用替代現金或銀行保函形式的投標保證金****（**⚠️ 不主張**其監管依據、費率結構或適用條件**；**亦**未核實** GeM 上是否確實接受該工具**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「該工具是什麼、依據何種監管框架被採用、以及如何取得」的三段式結構，是寫作方法上最值得記的****⭐⭐ **一份**最小可用的說明結構**：**定義 → 監管依據（含時間軸）→ 操作流程****；**而它把**政府原始文件**放進 `docs/` 並讓**監管時間軸直接引用這些文件**（逐字「source government documents **linked from the regulatory timelines**」）——**即**結論可追到原文****（可與第 333 輪 [[proof-protocol]] 的「證據隨主張同行」並讀）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「八種非英文譯文尚未經母語者審閱，且法律術語在依賴前應先核實」是本條目的核心**——**逐字「> The **eight non-English translations have not yet been reviewed by native speakers**. **Legal terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) should be verified before this is relied upon.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三點值得單獨記**：①聲明的是**自己剛做出來的那部分**（譯文）**不可盡信**；②**點名了三個具體法律術語**（obligee／bid security／EMD）；③措辭為「**before this is relied upon**」——**不是「僅供參考」的套話，而是指明依賴前須完成的一步****（**⚠️ 不主張**其英文原文本身準確**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **十種語言逐字且含八種印度文字**：English、हिंदी、**Hinglish**、বাংলা、मराठी、ગુજરાતી、தமிழ்、తెలుగు、ಕನ್ನಡ、മലയാളം**⭐⭐ **兩點值得記**：①**Hinglish**（印地語以拉丁字母書寫的混寫體）被單列為一種語言——**實務中真實存在卻少見於正式本地化清單的書寫形態**；②其餘八種均為印度主要語言且各有獨立文字**（**⚠️ **GeM Sahayak** is **an educational reference site on insurance surety bonds used as bid security** (repository `axt-asmi/gem-sahayak`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, HTML as the primary language, a 31,056 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file** and **no topics**; **the README measures 1,300 bytes, the shortest in this batch**. **Key files measurably present (all HTTP 200)**: **`index.html`, `i18n.js`, `serve.py` and `how-to-apply.pdf`**. It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **writing the boundary as a list**, **and the only one that states most directly that its own output cannot be fully trusted**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the title reads verbatim "GeM Sahayak — Surety Bonds"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **its positioning, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"An educational reference on Insurance Surety Bonds as Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM): what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted, and the procedure for obtaining one."** **Its contents read verbatim**: **`index.html` — the site (single page, no build step)**; **`i18n.js` — translations for ten languages**; **`docs/` — source government documents linked from the regulatory timelines**; **`how-to-apply.pdf` — the application walkthrough deck (30 slides)**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Insurance surety bonds used as bid security is the entry’s most notable point on product design** — verbatim above. ⭐⭐ **For students of insurance innovation this is a function quite unlike conventional property or liability cover: it does not indemnify a loss, it supplies the bidder’s performance credit to the buyer — the surety class of business whose economic substance is replacing cash or a bank guarantee with an insurer’s credit** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the instrument’s regulatory basis, rate structure or conditions of use — its body text and the government documents it cites were not read; ⚠️ nor was it verified that GeM currently accepts the instrument, or at what scale**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its three-part structure — what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted, and how to obtain one — is the entry’s most notable point on writing method** — verbatim above. ⭐⭐ **For a student who has to explain an unfamiliar financial instrument to others, it is a minimal usable structure: definition, regulatory basis with a timeline, then procedure**; **and it places the source government documents in `docs/` with the regulatory timeline linking directly to them** (**verbatim: "`docs/` — source government documents linked from the regulatory timelines"**) — **so conclusions can be traced back to the primary text** (**readable with round 333’s [[proof-protocol]] and "evidence should travel with information"**; **⚠️ the entry does not verify which documents `docs/` contains, nor their accuracy**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ That its eight non-English translations have not been reviewed by native speakers, and that legal terms should be verified before reliance, is the entry’s core and the most direct form of this round’s theme** — verbatim: **"> The eight non-English translations have not yet been reviewed by native speakers. Legal terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) should be verified before this is relied upon."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **it disclaims the very part it has just produced (the translations) rather than issuing a general caveat**; **it names three specific legal terms — obligee, bid security, EMD — i.e. it points at the three places a reader is most likely to be misled**; **and its conditional reads "before this is relied upon", not boilerplate about "for reference only" but a step that must be completed first**. **For students producing multilingual insurance material this is a sample of declaring translation quality and legal accuracy separately** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the English source itself is accurate — its content and cited government documents were not checked**). **④ ⭐⭐ Its ten languages read verbatim and include eight Indian scripts**: **English, हिंदी, Hinglish, বাংলা, मराठी, ગુજરાતી, தமிழ், తెలుగు, ಕನ್ನಡ and മലയാളം** ⭐⭐ **Two points deserve note**: **Hinglish (Hindi written in Latin script) is listed as a language in its own right — an orthographic practice that genuinely exists but rarely appears in formal localisation lists**; **and the other eight are major Indian languages each with its own script, a practical coverage list for students working on the Indian market** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the list covers all major Indian languages — Punjabi and Odia, for instance, are absent**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ That all strings live as key-value pairs in one i18n file with missing keys falling back to English is the entry’s most notable engineering point** — verbatim: **"All strings live in `i18n.js` as key–value pairs. Missing keys fall back to English."** ⭐⭐ **For students delivering multilingual material it is a minimal and reviewable approach — translations are not scattered across files** (**readable with the site’s [[llm-wiki]], [[md-translator]], [[action-translation]] and [[seo-hreflang]] entries**); **and "missing keys fall back to English" is an explicit degradation rule, so a missing translation shows neither a blank nor a raw key** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the fallback works in the implementation — `i18n.js` was not read**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ "Single page, no build step" and how to run it read verbatim, a delivery form rarely seen here**: **verbatim "`index.html` — the site (single page, no build step)"**; **running it verbatim as `python3 serve.py 8777 .` then `http://localhost:8777`**; **and verbatim "`serve.py` sends no-cache headers so edits appear on a normal reload."** ⭐⭐ **Two points**: **no build step means anyone who can open HTML can edit it — the lowest-threshold delivery form for teaching material**; **and sending no-cache headers is a concrete usability detail that prevents seeing a stale page after an edit**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ The thirty-slide application walkthrough reads verbatim and is the instrument’s operational layer** — verbatim "`how-to-apply.pdf` — the application walkthrough deck (30 slides)" (**⚠️ the PDF was not opened, so its application steps are not restated**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its disclaimer reads verbatim and contains a self-statement directly relevant to the theme**: **"This is an educational awareness resource. It is not owned or maintained by any government authority and does not constitute legal or financial advice."** ⭐⭐ **"Not owned or maintained by any government authority" deserves separate note: material explaining the rules of a government marketplace states that it is not itself the authority — separating "I am describing someone else’s rules" from "I am that body"** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its content matches official rules — no government text was checked**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s Indian insurance and learning entries**: [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[irdai-ai-governance]], [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]], [[iai-india]], [[indian-health-claims-skill]], [[open-exam-prep]], [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]], [[actuarial-student-competitions]], [[md-translator]] and [[llm-wiki]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence situation**: **the GitHub API licence field measurably reads `NONE`**, **its README’s Contents section lists no `LICENSE` file**, **and the README contains no licence statement whatsoever** (**a no-statement case**); **no licence declaration means all rights are by default reserved, and authorisation must be confirmed before using, copying, modifying or redistributing its pages, translations, deck or the government documents it collects**; **⚠️ one further point must be flagged**: **its `docs/` directory describes itself as holding "source government documents", i.e. it brings third-party government files into the repository, and those files’ own reuse conditions may differ from the repository code’s** (**the file list under `docs/` was not checked, nor were those documents’ reuse terms**; **the entry does not claim that collection complies with any reuse condition**); **②** this check verified **the repository metadata and the README’s full 1,300 bytes covering its positioning, four contents items, ten-language list, unreviewed-translation statement, run instructions with the no-cache note, and disclaimer**, **and confirmed by raw probe that four files exist (HTTP 200)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, open the site (the contents of `index.html` and `i18n.js` were not read), run `serve.py`, open `how-to-apply.pdf`, read any government document under `docs/`, or browse the site in any language**, so **its explanatory text, regulatory timeline, application steps and any language’s translation cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its explanation of insurance surety bonds is accurate was not verified** — **its definition, the regulatory basis and timeline under which the instrument was adopted, and the actual procedure for using it on GeM** (**its body text was not read, and no Indian government text or IRDAI rule was consulted**); **the entry does not claim its content is accurate, current or complete**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The actual quality of its eight non-English translations was not verified** — **⚠️ the author has already stated that those eight have not been reviewed by native speakers**; **the entry therefore does not claim any translation is usable for any formal purpose**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ The rendering of its three named terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) in each language was not verified**, **and the entry does not claim its terminology is legally correct in any jurisdiction**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether GeM actually accepts insurance surety bonds as bid security, and the current scope and scale of that practice, were not verified** (**no GeM official rule was consulted**); **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether the government documents under `docs/` are complete, current and unaltered was not verified** — **⚠️ in multilingual and legal material this bears directly on dependability**; **⑧ ⭐ Whether "missing keys fall back to English" actually works in `i18n.js` was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ How its interface actually renders in ten languages was not verified** (**the site was not opened**); **⚠️ in particular the readability of the Indian scripts under real browser fonts was not verified**; **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ The project describes itself as educational awareness material, explicitly not legal or financial advice, and not owned or maintained by any government authority**, **so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real bidding decision, legal judgement, compliance step or procurement activity**; **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-09-07 and pushed 2026-09-08**, **attention is very low**; **⚠️ its repository measures 31,056 KB while the README is only 1,300 bytes — the bulk lies in the site and the deck rather than in documentation** (**⚠️ the specific source of that size was not verified and its directory tree was not listed; this is the entry’s observation, not the author’s**); **⑫ ⭐ No topics**; **⑬ The README is in English** — **recorded as such; ⚠️ the site supports ten languages, but which content beyond the README is translated was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/axt-asmi/gem-sahayak` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics);
